summary: Resets video-manager state on game restart. Logs an entry message through the debug-message buffer when StringSplitLoop succeeds, clears the session-type state via sub_42D210, then switches on the session type to set/clear three global flags (windowed vs fullscreen display modes). For session type 7, a guarded sub_42D210(...,1) re-arms the session state when scoring gate, setup-dir condition flag, HUD-disabled byte, and session-state check all permit. Ends by resetting the renderer state on `this`, zeroing the input axis dead zone and a race-dynamics value, initializing a display-list branch, and returning a float setter result. Called from Game_Restart (0x0042D7A0).

operations.description: If StringSplitLoop(dword_8AD25C, 2, aDDevF119992002_26, 1136) returns nonzero, the debug-message buffer was split on the path-prefix token; only then is the entry log written.
DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, aEnteredVidmanR) writes the 'entered VidMan restart' message using the debug-message buffer and its log string.
sub_42D210(&dword_7C569C, 0) clears the session-type state variable to 0 before the switch.

switch(dword_7C56A4) selects the display-mode flag configuration by session type; dispatch uses the jump table jpt_4FA689. Cases 0-4 clear flag 64 and set flag 128; case 5 sets flag 64 and clears flag 128; cases 6-7 set both flags 64 and 128; default clears both.
Cases 0-4 (falling through LABEL_6): GlobalFlagSetClear(64, 0) then GlobalFlagSetClear(128, 1), then GlobalFlagSetClear(256, 1).
Only when dword_7C56A4 == 7, and dword_8AB6E4 != 2, and !ConditionalFlagReturn(&dword_5EA43C), and byte_7CE254, and !SessionStateCheckWrapper(dword_7CD25C) is sub_42D210 re-arm invoked.
sub_42D210(&dword_7C569C, 1) sets the session-type state variable to 1, re-arming the session after the guarded check.
sub_4F9FC0(this, 0.0) resets the video-manager object state on this instance.
dbl_8AFEA8 = 0.0 zeroes the input-axis dead zone threshold.
ConditionalInitBranch(&dword_8AFCA8, dword_8AFCAC) initializes the render display-list pointer branch with the value at dword_8AFCAC.
return GlobalFloatSetter(0) — the function's result is the float-setter call outcome for literal 0.

unresolved: Semantic roles of flag values 64, 128, 256 are not confirmed by packet evidence; existing analysis suggests windowed/fullscreen display modes (DERIVED).
Reason for numeric literal 1136 as the StringSplitLoop token limit is unknown.
The semantic meaning of the two-argument vs single-argument GlobalFlagSetClear calls (set/clear pairs) is not confirmed.
Sub_42D210's state variable at 0x007C569C is only partially identified (session-type-related).
